header.title: 🧠 Lernstoff Wiki - Configuration Cockpit
header.description: Headless cognitive selective note-taking engine with zero-config out-of-the-box defaults. Single source of truth backed by .lernstoff/config.json.

daemon.statusFallbackSuffix: · ⚠️ Port {requestedPort} was occupied; temporarily running on {actualPort} (preferred port remains {requestedPort})
daemon.statusPendingRestartSuffix: · ⚠️ Port {port} saved — click Restart to switch
daemon.autoStartObsidianDesc: Automatically start the background daemon when this Vault is opened in Obsidian.
daemon.autoStartBootDesc: Register daemon as macOS LaunchAgent / Linux systemd user service to start on system boot.
daemon.serverPortDesc: Default HTTP port for daemon and MCP (auto-increments if busy).
daemon.cliPathDesc: Optional override path to the lernstoff binary executable.

agents.oneClickDesc: Inject cognitive selective note-taking protocol (SKILL.md) and MCP config into coding agents.

qmd.embedModelDesc: GGUF model URI for vector embeddings (default: embeddinggemma-300M-Q8_0).
qmd.rerankModelDesc: Cross-Encoder GGUF URI for Gate 2 & Gate 3 reranking (default: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B).
qmd.generateModelDesc: Local generation model URI for synthesis (optional).
qmd.inactivityTimeoutDesc: Idle time in milliseconds before unloading native llama.cpp model context.
qmd.maintenanceDesc: Maintain QMD vector/keyword index, pull models, and clean up decayed scratchpad entries.

gates.gate2TauOffDesc: Candidates below this cross-encoder score are silently discarded (< 0.35).
gates.gate2TauCoreDesc: Candidates between τ_off and τ_core defer to scratchpad; >= τ_core enter Gate 3.
gates.gate3MaxSemDesc: Propositions with semantic similarity >= this and low novelty are discarded.
gates.gate3MinLexDesc: Threshold for n-gram lexical novelty before proposition is accepted.
gates.socraticMinLinksDesc: Minimum outbound proposition links required for crystallized notes.
gates.scratchpadTtlDaysDesc: Number of days unreferenced scratchpad entries survive before GC archival.
gates.scratchpadPromoteHitCountDesc: Collision count required across distinct sources to trigger proposition promotion.
gates.resetDesc: Restore all cognitive gate sliders and thresholds to factory values.

paths.inquiriesFileDesc: Relative path to the curiosity question tree.
paths.scratchpadFileDesc: Relative path to the fast scratchpad buffer.
paths.conceptsDirDesc: Relative folder for evergreen proposition notes.
paths.wikiDirDesc: Relative root folder for all synthesized wiki content.
paths.indexFileDesc: Relative path to global constellation index.
paths.logFileDesc: Relative path to cognitive event and gate audit log.
